claims.content: The use case is triggered when a NEW customer decides to register on the Website by creating an account and accesses Registration Page 1.
The Customer wants to create a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to create a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A new customer completes the registration process and creates a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer begins creating a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has successfully created a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
in_scope_actions: Create a free membership account on JTVauctions.com
excluded_adjacent_actions: Checkout or payment after winning an auction
Signing in to an existing account
variant_dimensions: Selectable registration options/categories presented to the Customer during the registration flow

claims.content: If the email address entered by the Customer already exists in the customer table, registration cannot proceed; the system notifies the registrant that the email address is already in use and asks whether they need to reset the password for that account. If the registrant indicates 'yes', the system generates an email with a temporary password.
If the Member ID ('Handle') entered by the Customer already exists in the customer table, registration cannot proceed.
If the password does not contain 8 to 12 characters, the input is invalid and registration cannot proceed.

If the Customer attempts to submit the registration before checking the Terms of Use checkbox, the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button is grayed out, preventing submission; if the grayed-out 'Finish Now' button is clicked, a popup message appears stating that the Customer must read and agree to the Terms of Use before proceeding.
If the Customer does not agree to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement, they cannot access or use the Website.

When a NEW customer attempts to create an account, the Consumer Protection negative file is cross-referenced; if a match is found, the registrant receives the message: "We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time. If you believe this message to be in error, please contact our Customer Service team at: 800-550-8393."
If the registrant is not 18 or over and is not between 13 and 18 with the permission of a parent or guardian, they are not in a permitted category and may not use the Website.
If the Customer's browser has cookies disabled, registration/site functionality will fail unless the Customer manually enables cookies.

missing_aspects: Main-flow step numbers: main_flow was not supplied, so exception branches cannot be bound to specific main-flow step numbers at authoring time.
Duplicate email: behavior when the registrant does not request a password reset is not documented.
Duplicate Member ID: recovery guidance for choosing an alternative handle is not documented.
Age eligibility: whether the system actively verifies the registrant's age during registration is not documented.
Cookies disabled: any system error message or automated recovery path is not documented.

claims.content: A free membership account is created for the Customer on JTVauctions.com; the system displays a confirmation after successful registration, and the 'My Account' link is accessible in the navigation bar.
After registration completes, any optional information provided by the Customer (billing/shipping addresses, shipping preferences) is saved to the Customer's account profile.
After the registration process completes (short or full), the system displays a 'Welcome Back!' message and presents the Sign In page with Member ID/Email and Password fields.

Upon successful registration completion, the system displays a pop-up message instructing the user to add shop@jewelryTV.rsys1.com to their address book or safe senders list and to enable cookies in their browser.

The system triggers an automated transactional email containing a 'Thank You' message for registering, along with instructions to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to the whitelist or Safe Senders list.

In the short-registration path completed with the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button, the Customer is taken to the Sign In page; if they were browsing before registering, they are returned to their last product details page, or to the home page if that was where they were before registering.
Customer

Diverges from Step 5: Instead of clicking 'I Want to Sign in Now!' to complete the short registration, the Customer proceeds to Registration Page 2, where they may optionally provide additional information such as billing/shipping addresses, shipping preferences, and email preferences; the Customer then clicks the 'Finish Now' button on Registration Page 2, and the system completes the full registration process, saving all provided optional information to the Customer's account profile.
The Customer is accessing the JTVauctions.com website.
The Customer has access to a valid email address and a valid phone number for account creation.
The Customer is a NEW customer who is not already registered on JTVauctions.com.
On Registration Page 1, the Customer enters their First Name and Last Name into the designated text fields.

The Customer provides an E-mail Address (entered twice and verified), creates a unique Member ID ('Handle'), and creates a Password of 8 to 12 characters, verifying it by re-entering it in the 'Verify Password' field.
The Customer selects a payment method (PayPal, Amazon Payments, or Credit Card) and, if Credit Card is selected, provides the corresponding billing details.
The Customer checks the box to accept and agree to the Terms of Use.
The Customer clicks the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button to complete the short registration process immediately without providing additional optional information.

quality_flags.detail: [mainflow_trigger_continuity] Precondition 2 requires the Customer to have access to a valid phone number for account creation, and trigger evidence includes 'required-info-entry', but the main flow never collects or uses a phone number. This leaves the preconditions/trigger disconnected from the main flow. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The cited evidence does not specify that the Phone Number is entered into designated text fields; EC-MF-011 supports providing/confirming it on the registration form.))

inconsistency_hints: Main Flow is the short-registration path only: it ends by clicking 'I Want to Sign in Now!' and never reaches Registration Page 2, the 'Finish Now' button, or a 'Save Changes' completion event. Postcondition claim at index 1 requires the full-registration path via 'Finish Now' on Registration Page 2, and claim at index 3 requires completion via 'Save Changes'; neither state is reachable from the specified Main Flow.

Main flow step 5 completes registration with the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button, but postcondition 4 is conditioned on completion via the 'Save Changes' button. No main-flow step leads to that postcondition, so the vertical flow is broken for this success guarantee.
